{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A structured wool-blend blazer, tailored fit with notch lapels, charcoal gray (#3E4246), and a smooth woven texture.  
Cotton poplin blouse with a relaxed collar, classic straight cut to mid-thigh length, crisp white (#FFFFFF), and breathable woven fabric.  
Tailored wool trousers, slim leg with a slight taper at the ankle, deep navy (#1A237E), and heavy-weight wool fabric for autumn warmth.  
Leather loafers with a low block heel, almond toe shape, neutral tan (#D2B48C), and soft full-grain leather.  

This outfit works because it balances professional polish with subtle comfort for a long day in the office, adhering to her request for something understated without bright accents. The charcoal and navy palette creates a sophisticated, grounded look that flatters the silhouette while remaining appropriate for an autumn setting. Textured fabrics like the wool blazer add visual interest without breaking the "no flashy" rule she emphasized."}
